charts.title: TOI-5678 b: orbits around TOI-5678
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-5678's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-5678 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Ulmer-Moll et al. 2023 (2023A&A...674A..43U), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname ULMER_MOLL_ET_AL_2023): P 47.73022 d

charts.title: TOI-5678 b: its transit
charts.description: TOI-5678 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (31, 97, 106) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 209464063, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 10 minutes earlier to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 27 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 28-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 10 min early; 28-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 9 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
